about: The Garden Gnome (G435; js/garden-gnome-art.js, features/garden-gnome-feature.js). tools/gnome-art/build.mjs renders glitch-items misc/npc/npc_garden_gnome/npc_garden_gnome.swf (CC0) sprite 31 at 1x into npc_garden_gnome.webp: the 80 different drawings of its 140 frames, 83x152 cells, 10 across. Here the same sprite renders at zoom 3; frameList is each cell's SWF frame (GNOME_ART.swfFrames). Lossy colour (q88) with lossless alpha keeps the 3x file near 1.4 MB; it swaps in when a gnome is first drawn. Run: node tools/vector-sprites/build.mjs --manifest tools/vector-sprites/garden-gnome.json
